---
title: Slide-Based Magic Move Demo — Other R Plotting Packages
format: revealjs
revealjs-plugins:
  - magic-move
---

## Base R Histogram - Normal {.magic-move}

```{r}
#| label: "base-hist-normal"
#| dev: svg
set.seed(42)
hist(
  rnorm(1000, mean = 0, sd = 1),
  breaks = 20,
  col = "steelblue",
  border = "white",
  main = "",
  xlab = "x",
  xlim = c(-5, 5),
  ylim = c(0, 200)
)
```

## Base R Histogram - Shifted {.magic-move}

```{r}
#| label: "base-hist-shifted"
#| dev: svg
set.seed(42)
hist(
  rnorm(1000, mean = 2, sd = 1),
  breaks = 20,
  col = "steelblue",
  border = "white",
  main = "",
  xlab = "x",
  xlim = c(-5, 5),
  ylim = c(0, 200)
)
```

## Base R Scatter + Line - Slope 20 {.magic-move}

```{r}
#| label: "base-slope-20"
#| dev: svg
plot(
  mtcars$mpg, mtcars$disp,
  pch = 19, cex = 2,
  xlim = c(10, 35), ylim = c(100, 500),
  xlab = "mpg", ylab = "disp"
)
abline(a = 0, b = 20, col = "pink", lwd = 5)
```

## Base R Scatter + Line - Slope 10 {.magic-move}
